## Introduction and overview {#intro}

  -------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Module               Hospital Immersion: Paired Project with a Physician
  Official title       Projet binôme avec un médecin – Immersion en hôpital
  Instructors          S. ALLASSONNIERE (master-mva.com, 2026–2027)
  Period               Both semesters (2026–2027); attached to semester 3 in the Gnome tool, run across the two semesters
  Credits and volume   5 ECTS · no scheduled hours; a workload of at least about thirty hours spread over the project (master-mva.com)
  Label                [Track Santé]{.badge .track} · in the Santé track it may replace one course
  Language             French (Université Paris-Saclay course detail)
  Assessment           An oral defence before the end of March: 15 minutes of presentation and 10 minutes of questions, in front of the referent physician, the other people the student worked with, and an MVA instructor
  Prerequisites        not displayed
  -------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This is a framing page, not a course. The module pairs a student with a physician on a real clinical question and real-life care data.

According to master-mva.com, it is neither an internship nor a research project. It is a first contact with medical questions in the field, with the skills needed to interpret them mathematically, and with real-world care data. The goal is to propose an answer to the physician's question with the tools of the master.

## What the module asks {#asks}

-   **Understand the need.** Talk with the physicians, with the people who collected the data and with other care staff, until the clinical question is stated precisely enough to be answered.
-   **Translate it into a statistical or learning problem.** What is the outcome, what are the covariates, what population does the data base represent, what would change a clinical decision?
-   **Propose a possible solution** from the data base entrusted to the student, with its limits stated plainly.

## How to prepare {#prepare}

The Santé-track pages of these notes cover most of the tools such a project needs:

-   study design, survival analysis and confounding: [Biostatistics](../s2-biostatistics/index.html);
-   estimation, EM and simulation methods: [Computational Statistics](../s1-computational-statistics/index.html);
-   images: [Medical Image Analysis](../s1-medical-image-analysis/index.html) and [Deep Learning for Medical Imaging](../s2-deep-learning-medical-imaging/index.html);
-   brain signals: [Functional Brain Imaging and Brain–Computer Interfaces](../s2-brain-imaging-bci/index.html);
-   shapes and anatomy: [Geometric Data Analysis](../s1-geometric-data-analysis/index.html) and [Geometry and Shape Spaces](../s2-shape-spaces/index.html).

Health data is personal data: anonymisation, access rules and the GDPR apply from the first day.

## Deliverables and assessment {#assessment}

-   An oral defence of 15 minutes followed by 10 minutes of questions, before the end of March, organised at the convenience of the student and the people involved.
-   The referent physician, the other people the student worked with, and an MVA instructor attend.

These are the official rules from master-mva.com; this page adds no assessment of its own.
